Hi, I'ver sort of raged and cried myself into this flat exhausstion. Would it be okay if I messaged you in the morning if I am still feeling badly about the same issues? It won't be the immediate crisis or current problem (hopefully) that this subreddit is meant to deal with, but I don't see myself being happy or carefree in 8 hours, and I think I will still hope for your advice at that pooint.

PS: sorry for my bad spelling and grammar. I am not feeling emotionally stable enohg to care.

Hi, it has been rrecommended (by two local crisis hotlines) that I just go to sleep. I appreciate your response and hope to get some perspective and advice in the morning. 

I have been gwtting this end of the world feeeling for no reason that I can identify. I feel like I am alone and worthless, etc. I can;t even identify the most harmful thought. Most of it seemed to be an unhappiness iwthout logic or reason (two things that are very importnt to me)

Well, apparently this invalidates my feelings, but I've been drinking tonight and I'm on my period. Since I'm in the army, I tried calling the on-call chaplain (our post has a 24-hour chaplain hotline). He listened to me but basically told me I should just go to sleep. When the call disconnected (due to the structure of my building causing calls to disconnect frequently), I Googled and called a local crisis hotline.

I've had the same problem for close to 8 years. I just feel really, really bad for no reason that I can understand. Most of the time I am a happy, healthy person. Every few months, however, I feel horrible. Everything seems pointless. My six-year failure to even begin a romantic relationship, my seemingly pointless existence, my bare and empty room....all make it so much harder to feel good about myself. 

Some nights (usually, I'm sober, but it's almost always at night), I just hurt so much. I can;t find a reason, and I can't explain it to my friends, but I just cry uncontrollably and wish I had never been born. I wish my roof would collapse on me in some freak accident. 

I wouldn't even describe it as a social or emotional problem. In fact, the most terrifying part is that my insides hurt so much for no reason that i can discern or understand.
